correctness.rationale: The package uses the established Gould–Grau–Johnson classification (t³=t,e²=e=te=et), the exact generator reduction m=3+r3+r2, and reconstructs t components as fixed stars or leaf-decorated two-cycles. A multiset of e-fibers yields R=z P Q/(1-z) and R0=zP/(1-z); an essential rank-two fiber has at most one extra t-fixed center, yielding MacMahon product minus P. The square-lift criterion for nonessential rank two is justified by constructing the two-cycle swapping two nondistinguished fixed centers. Independent Euler-product coefficient calculations produce 35,86,207,503,1206,2880 at n=5..10. The proof covers all n>=5; finite coefficients merely corroborate.
residual_risks: Structural reduction is imported from Gould–Grau–Johnson; no claim is made for exceptional n=4 or identity-preserving-only endomorphisms.
